settings.question: How much does membership cost?
settings.answer: Valurée Premium is $9.99 per month. Billing terms are displayed clearly before checkout.

settings.question: Are partner answers private?
settings.answer: Valurée is designed so partners receive shared recommendations without seeing each other’s raw answers.

settings.question: Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Yes. Exact cancellation timing and access rules will be provided in the approved policies before launch.
